label: Gender (teenager)
description: A teenager's gender: teenage girl, teenage boy, trans teenage girl, trans teenage boy or non-binary teenager. Each value stands for the adult gender it is tagged with (the gender facet), so a teenager's words narrowed on the adult gender list keep the same values here.
notes: Seeds a teenager's variants in place of person.gender, one value per variant by the same shares, when the person reads as a teenager (the who rule's stages). A teenager is written as a girl or a boy, never a woman or a man. Not a slot's list; the chooser offers person.gender, and a pick maps here by its gender tag.
